scientific_integrity: The exact positivity set is proved analytically. Computations provide finite corroboration only. Earlier general coefficient formulas and the 2024 open question are explicitly credited; no priority or independent certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Real dimension four only. The explicit norm coefficient follows from the published even-dimensional general formula; this result classifies its simultaneous sign in every degree. The classification does not extend to discrete residue spaces, higher dimensions, or Möbius invariance. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: Exact continuous Wallach set for hyperbolic-harmonic Bergman kernels on the real four-ball
